# Charity artwork

The charity names and logos belong to their respective organisations and are not
covered by Diffyn's MIT licence. They identify the independent charities linked
from the [donation page](../../DONATE.md); they do not imply endorsement of Diffyn.

| Organisation | Original logo | Original badge icon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| National Autistic Society | [Official SVG](https://www.autism.org.uk/Content/assets/general/img/logo.svg) | [Official icon](https://www.autism.org.uk/content/assets/favicon/favicon-32x32.png) |
| British Dyslexia Association | [Official SVG](https://cdn.bdadyslexia.org.uk/assets/v20261022_084056/img/logo.svg) | [Official icon](https://cdn.bdadyslexia.org.uk/assets/v20261022_084056/img/apple-touch-icon.png) |
| ADHD UK | [Official PNG](https://adhduk.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/ADHD-UK-Logo-Clear-Background-480x136.png) | [Official icon](https://adhduk.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cropped-ADHD-UK-Square-32x32.jpg) |

The logo panels preserve the original artwork on a white background for light
and dark themes. Donation buttons use [Shields.io](https://shields.io/) with the
charities' original icons.
